# Lab 10.2: Hive-Partitioned External Tables

## What We Are Going to Do
Create an external table over Hive-style `key=value` folders and see partition pruning on files.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Check the folders from Lab 3.3.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage ls gs://$PROJECT_ID-bq-labs/hive/names/</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   You see `year=2019/` and `year=2020/`.

2. **[SQL] Create the table.** Replace `YOUR_BUCKET`.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE lab10.names_hive
WITH PARTITION COLUMNS (year INT64)
OPTIONS (
  format = 'PARQUET',
  uris = ['gs://YOUR_BUCKET/hive/names/*'],
  hive_partition_uri_prefix = 'gs://YOUR_BUCKET/hive/names',
  require_hive_partition_filter = TRUE
);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Query one partition.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT gender, SUM(number) AS babies
FROM lab10.names_hive
WHERE year = 2020
GROUP BY gender;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Only files under `year=2020/` are read. A query without a `year` filter is rejected.

4. **[Console] Create the same table in the UI.** On `lab10` click **Create table**:
   - **Source**: Google Cloud Storage, path `gs://YOUR_BUCKET/hive/names/*`
   - **Table type**: External table
   - Tick **Source data partitioning**, prefix `gs://YOUR_BUCKET/hive/names/`, mode **Automatically infer types**

5. **[CLI] Add a new partition by adding files.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false "EXPORT DATA OPTIONS (uri='gs://$PROJECT_ID-bq-labs/hive/names/year=2021/part-*.parquet', format='PARQUET', overwrite=TRUE) AS SELECT name, gender, state, number FROM \`bigquery-public-data.usa_names.usa_1910_current\` WHERE year = 2021"
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false 'SELECT year, COUNT(*) FROM lab10.names_hive WHERE year &gt;= 2019 GROUP BY year'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Partition column | `year` from folder names |
| Pruning | Only matching folders are read |
| Required filter | Unfiltered queries rejected |
| New folders | Picked up automatically |
